explanation: The first human created by God, and the ancestor of all people.
The first woman, created by God from Adam's rib, and mother to all people.
Third son of Adam and Eve, born after Cain and Abel; regarded as the ancestor of the righteous line of humanity.
Son of Seth and father of Kenan; represents the continuation of humanity after Cain's evil deeds.
Son of Enosh and father of Mahalalel; part of the righteous line in Adam's family.
Son of Kenan and father of Jared; another leader in the righteous genealogy.
Son of Mahalalel and father of Enoch; his generation led to Enoch, who had a special relationship with God.
Son of Jared, known for his close relationship with God; was taken up to heaven without dying.
Son of Enoch and father of Lamech; known as the oldest person ever to have lived, at 969 years old.
Son of Methuselah and father of Noah; part of the righteous genealogy before the flood.
Son of Lamech, chosen by God to build the ark and save his family and the animals from the flood; ancestor of humanity after the flood.
